about: The blog's rubber-stamp pictures, one per article, shot in Minato by tools/minato-stamp-shoot.mjs. Ship frames: x across (+ port), y above the keel (engine-room floor plates at 0.9 m, bridge deck 10 m), z from the stern.

shots.name: blog-harbour
shots.note: The blog's header: the harbour with the Minato Maru alongside at dusk
shots.alt: Minato's harbour at dusk, printed as a rubber stamp from Johansson World.

shots.name: blog-harbour-ferry
shots.note: The blog header option: the Minato Maru alongside the quay at dusk, from across the harbour (not used: the camera stood over a roof)
shots.alt: The Minato Maru alongside the quay at dusk, printed as a rubber stamp from Johansson World.
